like: She often gazes up at the sky and chases drones that fly by, but they always seem to be just out of reach.
He has plenty of preferred hiding spots along Route 99, and can easily outrun any synth human that gives chase.
A regular at Ishar's for maintenance, it emits a rumbling purr while getting its battery charged.
She's often found lying belly-up after licking overripe dancing grass seeds, a plant with a taste said to resemble Mirth Punch.
He treats the archaeology buff's collection displayed in his second home as his own personal toys. That none have been broken yet is nothing less than a miracle.
She regards magmakin as her dearest friends, though it seems the feeling isn't mutual.
Eager to discover the taste of scarfin, his dream is to one day run along the shore with a defeated scarfin in his mouth.
She entices children into the wheat fields, only to abandon and force them to find their own way back.
She lingers near fishermen, hoping to be granted a portion of her favorite Baruoki kamasu.
In his quest to devour a king crab, he has attempted all manner of hunting strategies, from pouncing from high above to hurling his would-be prey against a rock. He is currently out of ideas.
Though he burrows eagerly into the sand baths of Zarbo, his ears and tail are often left peeking out.
She spends her days digging in the endless dunes of the Rucyana Sands, caring little for the artifacts she unearths.
He carries a torch for Ramses, but she's completely oblivious to his fiery affection.
She wanders around looking as though she hasn't had a single snack all day—a clever ruse for coaxing treats from the knights and priests.
Unable to forget the taste of the hermit crab a kind fisherman once shared with her, she attempts to sneak aboard every fishing boat she sees.
She once boldly charged a fearsome monster along the Serena Coast, only to succumb to a storm of furious chin rubs.

like: Frequently found gazing at the waterfall in the Charol Plains, it is unknown whether she waits for falling fish or marvels at the grandeur of nature.
Fond of sunbathing at the airport, he soaks in rays that touch even his fur’s roots, allowing him to maintain his luxurious sheen.
After a long day of work, it joins its engineer companions at the bar to replenish its oil as they knock back their drinks.
She swats at the vines of plum goblins, enjoying the uncertainty of the chase and the risk of entanglement.
A contender for Coco's affection. Despite seeing Varuo as his rival, he respects him and lends his support in fights with other cats.
When Sylph makes a rare appearance in the Zol Plains, he joins her to play. Afterward, his coat is left gleaming due to her conjuring winds.
Slow-cooked snot nose is her favorite dish, but the more she eats, the more her stomach resembles that of the monster.
The people of Rinde prepare Delish Fish Dish suited to his tastes to lure him into their homes. It's said that if he shows up for dinner, the next morning promises a plentiful catch.
He regards the monster-slaying knights of Miglance as his heroes. After a victory, he lets them rub his belly as a reward.
Though he once moved to the Vasu Mountains, the heat was unbearable. He finds the cool winds of the Zol Plains to be much more pleasant and agreeable.
She enjoys the thrill of island hopping, and knows that if anything goes wrong, the patrol drones will come to her rescue.
Overwhelmed by the adoration she was getting at Palsifal Palace, she made the Derismo Highroad her new home. On the rare occasions she returns, everyone vies for her attention.
After devouring a bowl of his favorite dish, soup made from acrylidactyl broth, he licks his paws so as not to waste even a single drop.
The glowing mushrooms of the Corinda Plains delight him, though his shadow—resembling that of a large black cat—always gives him a fright.
Enchanted by the cat in Acteul's waters, she reaches out, unaware that it's her own reflection...only to see it vanish before her eyes.
While fond of all the priests at the capital, she truly adores Mariel, whose petting is nothing short of divine.
On rainy days, he takes pleasure in the melodies of the rain falling on industrial barrels and metal scrap scattered along the empty road.
Once adored by King Palsifal, he worries about the king's recent distant behavior.
She enjoys climbing sarupa trees, feeling regal as she looks down on her subjects below.
He pursues and catches the falling lights in the Corinda Plains, but every time he opens his paw, they vanish, leaving him astonished.
A seasoned gourmand who's sampled countless local dishes in her travels. Now, she longs to try glowing mushrooms but has yet to muster the courage.
He enjoys napping at his favorite spot beneath Palsifal—one that is cool, damp, and delightful.
Grateful for his help, she has been grooming Gnome ever since he chased away some monsters, but he has yet to notice her because of her tiny frame.
As a kitten, she took shelter under the awning of Veron's house, and she remains friends with him to this day.
Day after day, he gazes up at the sky, curling and stretching as he assumes shapes like the clouds above.
The royal knights kneel to pet her whenever she passes, leading her to believe she's the most important knight of all.
Longing for the dried sardines once dropped by the oddly dressed man, he lies in wait for more, but is inevitably thwarted by the man's careful watch.
The windmills in Zarbo mesmerize her so completely that she's often seen sprawled on her back, overcome by a dizzy spell.
The gentle murmur of Acteul's waters was his childhood lullaby, and even the pouring of water now lulls him to sleep.
She enjoys playing tag with others in the Nuaru Uplands, flying across the flatlands and leaving a trail of broken blades of grass in her wake.
cond: Present after “You restored Salamander to his senses!” in Ch. 6

like: He's made a game of stealing fish from coeli, so much so that they now keep a close eye on him.
He enjoys snacking on cheese with milk, but bares his fangs when humans try to copy his tasty habit.
She truly adores King Miglance and will slip past his guards just to reach him.
He often plays hide-and-seek with Ven. He’d rather play tag, but stays quiet to avoid hurting his buddy.
She often plays hide-and-seek with Beel. She’d rather play tag, but stays quiet just to see her buddy happy.
The sound of the waters of the Serena Coast makes him purr, perhaps because it stirs memories of his mother.
She preys on ships docked at Rinde, mistaking them for colossal fish and claiming their sails as trophies.
Only fresh milk will get her to play with humans. If it isn't up to her standard, she won't even spare a glance.
He often hunts fish in the shallows of the Karek Swampland. At the first sight of scales beneath the surface, he leaps and captures his prey with ease.
